site_text.value: I have let the art be my guide moving me through many wordls painting cafes, restuaurants, hostels, and guesthouses.

Since 2020, I have been traveling the world sharing and exchanging my art. 
Each piece is not planned and instead reveals itself layer by layer 
stroke by stroke as a trust in the unfolding process. Painting is how I travel, support myself and connect with people.

This memory came at a time in my life when I need to let go of control. I was dealing with an addiction to an adhd medication that left me obessed with perfecting my world, and controlling my time. I beleived that the more I could do with my time the more successful I would be. Inside, however I was deeply disocnnected from my body and sense of purpose.

When I disocvered yoga I found a new side of reality I had never experinced. A inner process was revealing itself to me as I connected back to my body that opened up my world. It was revealing to that the time was not meant to be harvested and extracted to its maximun effecieny and there was an unknown journey I was meant to follow.

For the rest of my 20’s I followed an unknown process each day. I will never find the words to fully describe all the gifts that arrived when I began to trust in my time, however I hope to use this space and tell my story and open our imgination to see beyond what we have labeled as time.

This memory returned to me at a time when I desperately needed to let go of control. I had been caught in a cycle of over-controlling my world, fueled by an ADHD medication that made me obsessed with efficiency and maximizing each moment. I thought optimizing and externalizing my time was the key to success. Instead, it left me completely disconnected from my body and my deeper purpose.

Everything shifted when I discovered yoga. Connecting back to my body revealed a world I had never experienced before. An unfolding process began to emerge revealing that time wasn’t a resource meant to be harvested and or extracted for maximum output, but was instead an unknown journey meant to be felt.

I spent the rest of my twenties stepping into that unknown every single day. Seeing my time as a process rather than something to be planned or controlled reveals unknowns gifts to me everyday. Expressing a new side time is my hearts dream on this earth. 

This is a space to share everything that I have learned and created from time. Thank you for being a part of my dream here, we do this together.
